gaps.valueSet: YEFE-R6 paired acute and convalescent antibody comparisons
gaps.reason: the authoritative source says the four-fold rise and negative-to-positive seroconversion logic is not operational; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, collection intervals, titers, or seroconversion, so the numbered rule is omitted
the authoritative source marks the qualitative neutralizing-antibody value set not implemented with no LOINC codes; the quantitative neutralizing-antibody branch remains modeled
SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory result value comparison predicate; numeric alternatives in YEFE-R7, YEFE-R8, and YEFE-R9 are omitted
